values.note: Every RV site is a 'Campsite Electric' (50/30 A, water) at one of two prices that move with the date: 27 sites $35 and 39 sites $37 on Saturday 2027-06-19 (and 2027-06-15), but $37 and $39 on Tuesday 2026-11-10 and Saturday 2026-11-14. Walk-in tent sites $20, platforms $14, backcountry $12. The park page: 'Overnight guests pay daily ParkPass fee only once per vehicle during their stay ... Parking is not included with reservation.'

fees.source: https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/fort-mountain-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=GA&parkId=530158 (Campsite 14: $37 on 2026-11-10 and 11-14, $35 on 2027-06-19; Campsite 27: $39 / $39 / $37) + https://gastateparks.org/FortMountain (Parking: 'Fee required'), read 2026-10-29

hookups.source: gastateparks.reserveamerica.com parkId 530158 site details (all 66 public 'Campsite Electric' sites 'Electricity Hookup: 50/30', 'Water Hookup: Y', no sewer; 'Sewer Hookup: Y' only at host sites 03, 04, 69, 70), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 70 electric sites on the booking site, 4 of them host sites, leaving 66 for the public (the park page says 70). 57 take a 23-ft rig (53 at 50 ft, others 25-30 ft); 9 are 11-15 ft. 30 pull-throughs. Plus 4 walk-in tent sites, 6 platforms, 4 backcountry and 3 pioneer sites.

sites.source: gastateparks.reserveamerica.com parkId 530158 site details ('Max Vehicle Length', 'Driveway Entry', 'Host') + https://gastateparks.org/FortMountain ('70 Tent, Trailer & RV Campsites', '4 Walk-In Campsites', '6 Platform Campsites'), read 2026-10-29

booking.source: https://gastateparks.org/FortMountain (Reserve links to gastateparks.reserveamerica.com parkId 530158), read 2026-10-29

note: Mountaintop GA state park near Chatsworth. 17-acre lake with a summer beach. --Claude
summary: Park page + ReserveAmerica catalog: 66 public 50/30 A + water sites (70 less 4 host; no public sewer), $35/$37 in June 2027 but $37/$39 in November 2026 (fees widened 35-37 -> 35-39); 57 fit 23 ft (max 50, 30 pull-throughs); dump, showers, restrooms. Count 70 -> 66. Note trimmed of counts/hookups/booking. Pin is ~1.5 km off in unbroken forest - see flags. Pages carry no mountain-road or rig warning.
